title: grothlab/crepas pipeline - params.input schema
description: Schema for the file provided with params.input

sample.description: Custom sample (or condition) name. This identifier must be the same for all biological and technical replicates of the same sample; just specify a `biological_replicate` appropriately. For output file naming purposes, the sequencing experiment type is parsed from the `exp_type` column and prepended to the `sample` identifier, so you should avoid including the experiment type as part of the `sample` name. It cannot contain spaces.
sample.errorMessage: The sample identifier cannot contain spaces. It must be the same for all biological and technical replicates of the same sample.

biological_replicate.description: String or integer representing the biological replicate. This identifier should be identical for re-sequenced libraries (technical replicates). If you do not have biological replicates you can set the `biological_replicate` to any number or string for each of your samples. It cannot contain spaces.
biological_replicate.errorMessage: The biological replicate must be provided and cannot contain spaces. If you do not have biological replicates you can set the `biological_replicate` to any number or string for each of your samples.

technical_replicate.description: Identifier representing the technical replicate. It cannot contain spaces.

input_control.description: This column should contain the `sample` identifier of the corresponding input control for that sample. It should be empty if an input control is not available or in the case of input control rows.
input_control.errorMessage: The input control column cannot contain spaces

input_control_biological_replicate.description: String or integer representing the biological replicate of the corresponding input control sample. It should be empty in the case of input control rows.

input_control_technical_replicate.description: String or integer representing the technical replicate of the corresponding input control sample. It should be empty in the case of input control rows.

exp_type.errorMessage: Sequencing experiment type must be provided and be one of: 'ChIP-seq', 'ChOR-seq', 'SCAR-seq', 'eSPAN', 'ChIP-exo', 'ATAC-seq', 'OK-seq', 'Repli-seq', 'CUTandRUN', 'CUTandTag', 'TIP-seq'

rt_fraction.description: The cell-cycle fraction a `Repli-seq` sample was sorted into. Two designs are supported. Two- or three-fraction E/L Repli-seq uses `early`, `late` and optionally `mid`. Sixteen-fraction high-resolution Repli-seq uses `S1` (earliest) to `S16` (latest), optionally with a `G1` whole-genome-sequencing control used to correct each S-phase fraction for mappability. One `sample` may carry both, in which case both analyses run over their own fractions and write to their own directories.
rt_fraction.errorMessage: Replication-timing fraction must be one of 'early', 'mid', 'late', 'G1' or 'S1' to 'S16'. Required for 'Repli-seq' samples. Use 'early'/'mid'/'late' for E/L Repli-seq and 'S1'..'S16' (optionally with a 'G1' control) for high-resolution Repli-seq. A sample may carry both designs, in which case both analyses run.

strandedness.description:
Either `forward` or `reverse`. `forward` means Read1 aligns to the original nascent forward strand and Read2 to the original nascent reverse strand (similar to FR/fr-secondstrand/ISF stranded libraries). `reverse` means Read1 aligns to the original nascent reverse strand and Read2 to the original nascent forward strand (similar to RF/fr-firststrand/ISR stranded libraries).

  • If the library was prepared using NGS indexed PentAdapter™ adapters (PentaBase ApS, Denmark), as in the [SCAR-seq paper](https://doi.org/10.1038/s41596-021-00585-3), set this to `forward`.
  • If the library was prepared using [xGen™ UDI-UMI Adapters](https://eu.idtdna.com/page/products/next-generation-sequencing/ngs-adapters-indexing-primers) (Integrated DNA Technologies, Inc.), the [insert strandedness is flipped](https://eu.idtdna.com/pages/support/faqs/can-the-xgen-unique-dual-index-umi-adapters-be-used-for-rna-seq), so set this to `reverse`.

This field is required for SCAR-seq and OK-seq and is optional for eSPAN, where it defaults to `forward`. Leave it empty for all other experiment types.

antibody.description: This column is required to separate the downstream consensus peak merging for different antibodies. It is not advisable to generate a consensus peak set across different antibodies especially if their binding patterns are inherently different e.g. narrow transcription factors and broad histone marks. It should be empty in the case of input control rows.

with_umi.description: Must be set to `true` for samples that contain UMIs, either in the read sequence, in the read name, or in a separate FastQ file (`fastq_umi`). If your samples contain UMIs, but they are not in a separate FastQ file, set `with_umi` to `true` and leave the `fastq_umi` column empty.
with_umi.errorMessage: `with_umi` must be set to true for samples that contain UMIs, either in the read sequence, in the read name, or in a separate FastQ file (`fastq_umi`). If your samples contain UMIs, but they are not in a separate FastQ file, set `with_umi` to true and leave the `fastq_umi` column empty.

extract_umi.description: If the UMIs are contained in the read sequence, `extract_umi` must be set to `true` to move them to the read name. If the UMIs have already been extracted and moved to the read name, set `extract_umi` to `false`.
extract_umi.errorMessage: If the UMIs are contained in the read sequence, `extract_umi` must be set to true to move them to the read name. If the UMIs have already been extracted and moved to the read name, set `extract_umi` to false.

fastq_1.description: GZIP-compressed FastQ file for reads 1. Must have the extension `.fastq.gz` or `.fq.gz`.
fastq_1.errorMessage: GZIP-compressed FastQ file for reads 1 must be provided, cannot contain spaces and must have extension '.fq.gz' or '.fastq.gz'

fastq_2.description: GZIP-compressed FastQ file for reads 2. Must have the extension `.fastq.gz` or `.fq.gz`. Leave empty for single-end data.
fastq_2.errorMessage: GZIP-compressed FastQ file for reads 2 cannot contain spaces and must have extension '.fq.gz' or '.fastq.gz'

fastq_umi.description: GZIP-compressed FastQ file for UMI reads. Must have the extension `.fastq.gz` or `.fq.gz`. Leave empty if a separate UMI file is not available.
fastq_umi.errorMessage: GZIP-compressed FastQ file for UMI reads cannot contain spaces and must have extension '.fq.gz' or '.fastq.gz'
